mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (lower unemployment) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE declines below 4.4% in the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS tightening phases.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of FEDFUNDS above 4% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4% in the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of UNRATE above 4.4% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.4%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 (demand) signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines and GDPC1 rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in GDPC1 and HOUST (both demand indicators) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions when FEDFUNDS declines.
